title: LexGuard Inc.
text:
LexGuard Inc.

next_step:
Schedule SSO+latency POC (internal IDE integration) + finalize security questionnaire answers

blockers:
legal sign-off on data retention policy
procurement budget window Q2
network team needs VPC peering design

notes:
Primary ask: enterprise-grade IDE copilot deployed into customer VPC or on-prem control plane.
Key constraints: SAML SSO (Okta), strict audit logs for all prompt/response pairs, 7yr retention requirement for legal-relevant artifacts.
Latency target: <100ms token-response for inline completions in VS Code plugin; streaming required (low-latency partial tokens).
Throughput: 200 concurrent developer sessions expected at peak for EU engineering org.
Model needs: must be able to pin model version per-team (v1.12-int8 preferred), fallback routing to family-compatible variant during outages.
Security: mandatory KMS/HSM integration, per-route audit hooks and immutable append-only logs. Data residency must be eu-west-1 for primary tenancy.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-18): "We cannot have prompts leave our VPC without customer-controlled keys. Also need clear provenance for every suggestion."
POC scope agreed: 1) SSO + onboarding flow (Okta test org), 2) Perf test (streaming latencies) using internal VS Code extension, 3) Security questionnaire + pentest window.
Security questionnaire status: 60% complete. Info on key management and audit streams pending (security asked for HSM diagram).
Integration notes: platform team will be responsible for VPC peering and firewall rules; they requested a network topology diagram from Redwood.
Pricing sensitivity: medium-high — willing to pay for private deployment but needs predictable committed ARR. Interested in Reserved capacity pricing for baseline throughput.
Internal champions: Head of Platform (Ana-Maria Voss) and Senior Developer Advocate (Sameer Khan).
Recent activity: demo with infra + security teams (2026-02-18), follow-up call to review SAML metadata (2026-02-25), handed security Q to Redwood (2026-02-26).
POC timeline: Week 0: SSO handshake and identity mapping; Week 1: deploy private control plane in staging VPC; Week 2: run 48h perf harness; Week 3: security review + retention policy test.
Open technical questions: how does Redwood surface per-prompt provenance metadata in audit logs? can KV cache be selectively disabled per route?
Tactical next step: book 90-min POC planning with SE + infra (Priya lead) — target week of 2026-03-15. SE to share runbook and topology template.
Blocker detail: procurement prefers one legal review cycle before test; legal wants export controls clause clarified for model artifacts.
Win criteria for LexGuard: streaming latency <100ms tail, SSO working end-to-end, audit logs available in immutable store accessible via their SIEM, signed DPA and SOC2/ISO evidence.
Notes style: fragments, action items, call paraphrases — kept short for quick AE skimming.
AE playbook suggestions: propose 6-month reserved capacity + 1yr opt-in for on-prem license; include Add-on: extended logging retention (7yr) as paid SKU.
